recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast monochrome composition featuring a large, solid black five-pointed star centered in the upper two-thirds, supported by a row of five smaller, fragmented geometric star-based shapes aligned horizontally at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the dominant central star and the smaller footer elements
Vertical hierarchy moving from a whole form to deconstructed parts
Strict alignment of the footer elements to the horizontal width of the main star
High-contrast relationship between solid black silhouettes and a pure white background
coreInvariants: Sharp, clean vector edges with no gradients or textures
Five-pointed star geometry as the foundational motif

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central star occupies the upper 70% of the frame; smaller icons occupy the bottom 10%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central black star acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large star and drops vertically to decode the smaller, abstract shapes at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounds the elements, emphasizing the starkness of the black forms.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White background provides a clean, clinical canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black forms create a bold, graphic silhouette.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Maximum value contrast (0 vs 100) with zero saturation.

letterConstructionRules: Each 'character' is a deconstruction of a five-pointed star
characterSpecificRedesigns: Leftmost element is a single star point
Central element is a horizontal bisection of a star
Rightmost element is a star with one point removed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Visual echo of the primary subject's geometry.

candidateDirections.reason: The footer elements function as a cryptic visual language rather than standard text.
Similar to symbolic glyph sets based on geometric shapes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a large, perfectly symmetrical solid black five-pointed star centered on a pure white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal row of five smaller black geometric icons below the star. Each icon should be a unique fragment or variation of a five-pointed star, spaced evenly.

verificationChecks: Is the composition strictly black and white?
Is the large star perfectly centered?
Do the bottom icons align with the width of the main star?

adjustableVariables: Scale ratio between the large star and small icons
mustRedesign: Any specific arrangement that mimics a protected trademarked logo
Specific glyph shapes that form a recognizable brand name
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray pixels exist at the boundaries
Verify the horizontal alignment of the footer row
recipe.reuseFormula: Central large geometric motif + Deconstructed footer row of the same motif = Minimalist Symbolic Layout
